title: ROTC Cadets, Military Commencement Walk - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor academic and military procession captured in March 1966, depicting an ROTC commissioning or college commencement ceremony. A column of young servicemen in military dress uniforms and visor caps marches along a sunlit concrete sidewalk, trailed by graduates in academic caps and gowns. Spectators line the lawn, including a bystander taking a photograph with a handheld camera and a man in a dark suit standing in the foreground.
